sources.label: Morphe patches: Sony Xperia 1 VI camera app on the Xperia 1 V
sources.author: alalloush Xperia 1 V camera
patch_list: Fixes "Memory unavailable" on ROMs that cannot create Android/data/<pkg>/files (LineageOS on the Xperia 1 V): the storage probe falls back to the app's internal storage. Photos still go to DCIM through MediaStore.
